description:
Revoke the ephemeral token when you're done. Self-deletes if the token has
    the rights; otherwise returns the token id + steps to delete it in the
    dashboard. Give it the same way you did for cloudflare_apply - PREFERRED
    token_file=<path> (or ZX_CF_TOKEN_FILE / ZX_CF_TOKEN, or token_cred=<vault id> on the
    gateway); token=… inline also works but hits the transcript. Token is never echoed.
    Like every mutation this is dry_run by default and needs confirm=true to delete.
name: cloudflare_revoke_token
